senses.gloss: Alone in a category.
Not accompanied by anything else; one in number.
Without outside help.
Numerically indivisible by two.
Being only one of a larger population; single, individual.
A single object, especially one of a group.
In a curve or twist corresponding to the movement of the hands of a clock.
The act of setting oneself on fire, especially as a form of protest.
Widely open to new ideas, willing to depart from established opinions or conventions; permissive.
Willing to consider new and different concepts, ideas, or opinions.
Having an open mind; tolerant of diversity; with broad views on different issues.
To put in or on a particular place with force and loud noise. (Often followed by a preposition such as down, against or into.)
Not the same; exhibiting a difference.
Apart from (the rest); not connected to or attached to (anything else).
The name of the Latin script letter B/b.
Used as an intensifier in various interjections.

A telecommunication device which converts data or sounds (usually speech) into electrical signals which are then transmitted to enable two or more people to communicate with each other over a distance; now usually a device having a dial or keypad with numerals for entering a number, etc., to connect with a person, and means (such as a sound or vibration) for alerting one to an incoming call or transmission; also, the handset or receiver of such a device.
A situation which poses an immediate risk and which requires urgent attention.
A room in a house intended for reading and writing; traditionally the private room of the male head of household.
A period of time equal to thirty minutes, half an hour.
Moving up and down like waves; wavy.
Swelling or swollen into large waves; full of billows or surges; resembling billows.
bird from the Canary Islands
A cosmetic designed to cover blemishes.
An access point or conduit for rainwater that drains directly downstream in a (drainage) basin without going through sewers or water treatment in order to prevent or belay floods.
To make mention of; to speak of; to refer to; to name; to specify
A state of tranquility, quiet, and harmony. For instance, a state free from civil disturbance.
The part of space within one's immediate vicinity.
Perfect happiness.
At frequent intervals.
A manned vehicle that flies through space.
A way of thinking; an attitude or opinion, especially a habitual one.
An intermediary or middleman.
One who acts for, or in the place of, another (the principal), by that person's authority; someone entrusted to act on behalf of or in behalf of another, such as to transact business for them.
Someone who moderates.
One who negotiates between parties seeking mutual agreement.
An agent acting as a mediator between sides to facilitate agreement or cooperation.
An intermediate dealer between the manufacturer and the retailer or customer.
one who intercedes
In a circle around; all round; on every side of; on the outside of; around.
Forming a circle or closed curve containing (something).
area of land completely surrounded by water
group of buildings demarcated by streets
A usually plastic card which stores a digital signature that is used to operate an electronic access control lock.
The product or end result of an act of translating, in its various senses.
Having a tendency to steal.
Skillful with one's hands.
A large open space for children to play in, usually having dedicated play equipment (such as swings and slides).
A page on a wiki where users are free to experiment without destroying or damaging any legitimate content.
The flat, horizontal upper surface of a table.
Wild animals hunted for food.
An animal, often a bird or mammal, which is hunted.
A sound produced by the vocal cords with relatively little restriction of the oral cavity, forming the prominent sound of a syllable.
The upper part of a cavity.
The upper limit of an object or action.
A small, round, smooth-skinned edible fruit, usually purple, red, or green, that grows in bunches on female vines of most species of genus Vitis and the self-fertile plants of species Vitis vinifera.
Composed of inherently different or distinct elements; incongruous.
To do as one is told.
A deciduous tree of the genus Platanus.
Any of several North American plane trees, of the genus Platanus, especially Platanus occidentalis (American sycamore), distinguished by its mottled bark which flakes off in large irregular masses.
Continuing in a course of action without regard to discouragement, opposition or previous failure.
Without hope; despairing; not expecting anything positive.
Capable of being flexed or bent without breaking; able to be turned or twisted without breaking.
able to withstand force without cracking; elastic
A reddish plant substance, prepared from the dried leaves of this plant, used for temporary tattoos and hair coloring. Hair colorings range from bright red to earth brown to near black.

One who willingly accepts being put to death or willingly accepts challenging and exposing iniquity done to oneself for adhering openly to one's religious beliefs; notably, saints canonized after red martyrdom.
A microprocessor.
The part of an object which is (designed to be) held in the hand when used or moved.
The stem or main axis of a plant.
Information which may lead one to a certain point or conclusion.
A clue.
An assertion of untruth.
Relating to electromagnetism.
A cause or instance of sorrow or pain; that which afflicts or distresses; a trial.
Great sadness or depression, especially of a thoughtful or introspective nature.
Deep sadness or gloom; melancholy
A piece of cloth, usually square and often fine and elegant, carried for wiping the face, eyes, nose or hands.
A long-distance, or privately hired, bus.
The cardinal number occurring after eighty-nine and before ninety-one, represented in Roman numerals as XC and in Arabic numerals as 90.
A person who arranges the details of a public event.
endlessness, unlimitedness, absence of a beginning, end or limits to size.
Existence without end, infinite time.
Eternity, the duration of the universe.
bathing suit
A person who favors maintenance of the status quo.
place where some sports take place
Any small saltwater fish of the Engraulidae family, consisting of 160 species in sixteen genera, those of the genus Engraulis being widely sold as food.
A sword-like tool used for cutting large plants with a chopping motion, or used as a weapon.
In a cordial, warm, friendly or heartfelt manner.
The state of being obese.
Of, relating to, or afflicted by disease.
An adherent of a religion.
The act of initiating hostilities or invasion.
The state or quality of being aggressive.
Representing the sound of a dog barking.
An act of shifting; a slight movement or change.
One who attends to the maintenance of a building and provides services to its tenants and visitors.
A janitor; a cleaner.

A person who holds open the door at the entryway (entrance) to a building, summons taxicabs, and provides an element of security; in apartment buildings, he also accepts deliveries and may perform certain concierge type services.
Someone who intrudes.
of an animal
The action of vindicating; also, the state of being vindicated.
A kind of bird, many species of which are colorful and able to mimic human speech, of the order Psittaciformes or (narrowly) of the family Psittacidae.
place at disposal
To explicitly mention (something) as a possibility for consideration, often to recommend it.
To spur on, strongly recommend.
Of or relating to administering or administration.
To apply a force to (an object) such that it moves away from the person or thing applying the force.
To vandalize (a car, etc.) by scratching with an implement such as a key.

A semitransparent, uncrystallized silicate mineral and semiprecious stone, presenting various tints in the same specimen, with colors delicately arranged and often curved in parallel alternating dark and light stripes or bands, or blended in clouds; various authorities call it a variety of chalcedony, a variety of quartz, or a combination of the two.
The act or state of deliberately not paying attention or caring about something.
A notebook used to organize and maintain such plans or lists, an agenda book, an agenda planner.
Someone or something that reminds.
An autobiography; a book describing the personal experiences of an author.
A notebook or software in which one keeps reminders of items such as appointments, tasks, projects, and contacts.
A keepsake; an object kept as a reminder of a place or event.
A disease entity involving such beats, such as atrial fibrillation, ventricular tachycardia, AV nodal reentrant tachycardia, or others.
White or grey with age.
Conversation or debate concerning a particular topic.
A substance or liquid which is believed to cure all ills and give eternal life.
One of a series of curves, forming an edge similar to a scallop shell, especially in knitting and crochet.
Digested waste material (typically solid or semi-solid) discharged from a human or other mammal's stomach to the intestines.
Talk, especially meaningless or unimportant talk.
Talk to little purpose; trifling talk; unmeaningful loquacity.
With respect to the closing of a letter, formal and professional.
One who denies the existence of something.
rapeseed plant
Oilseed rape (Brassica napus), cultivated for its seeds, which yield an oil, valued for illuminating and lubricating purposes.
animal — see also donkey
A domestic animal, Equus asinus asinus, similar to a horse.
A winter sport where players aim and slide stones down a sheet of ice and attempt to get their color stones closest to the house (a circular target marked on the ice).
The seed of this plant.
A disease spread by mosquito, in which a protozoan, Plasmodium, multiplies in blood every few days.
Serving to reduce a difficulty, or accessible with minimum difficulty; expedient.
Harm or injury:
To shine; to make a surface very smooth or shiny by rubbing, cleaning, or grinding.
To make (something, such as a surface) bright, shiny, and smooth by, or (by extension) as if by, rubbing; to polish, to shine.
Having a tendency to fuss, cry, or be bad-tempered/ill-tempered (especially of babies).

Having a sound imparted by means of the nose; and specifically, made by lowering the soft palate, in some cases with closure of the oral passage, the voice thus issuing (wholly or partially) through the nose, as in the consonants m, n, ng.
A person who treats diseases by means of medicinal herbs.
To repeat (exactly what has just been said) without necessarily showing understanding, in the manner of a parrot.
The common mineral iron disulfide (FeS₂), of a pale brass-yellow color and brilliant metallic luster, crystallizing in the isometric system.
Any of various radical social or political movements that aim at fundamental change in the structure of society
To make calm.
To make quiet; to calm; to reduce (something) to a state of peace; to dispel (anger, hatred, etc.).
to calm or placate
pacify
To calm (a person or animal) or put them to sleep using a tranquilizer dart.
Dogmatic or partisan.
A symbol, seal, amulet, or gem fashioned to resemble the sacred beetle.
Relating to respiration or the organs of respiration; breathing.
Without a state or nationality; not subject to any state.
Tending or used to cure disease or relieve pain.
A plant of the genus Trifolium with leaves usually divided into three (rarely four) leaflets and with white or red flowers.
Any of several plants of the pea family, having compound, trifoliate leaves; especially one of the genus Trifolium.
Ellipsis of trance music (“genre of electronic dance music”).
A shrill noise, especially made by a voice or bird. If made by a bird, it typically signals discomfort or anger; a yell, scream, or call.

A female fictional character from non-live-action visual media (typically an anime, manga, or video game) or non-fictional persona to whom one is romantically attracted and/or whom one considers one's wife.
A vehicle which can operate on both land and water.
To infer or conclude; to know from a different source.
A fast-moving streak of light in the night sky caused by the entry of extraterrestrial matter into the earth's atmosphere; a shooting star or falling star.
